name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 24 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.23 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
